### How to Read a Thunderstorm
Author: Seth Porch
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/how-to-read-a-thunderstorm
Passage: Nahum 1:7
Points:
- Severe natural thunderstorms vividly illustrate the terrifying reality of divine wrath against sin.
- Nahum declared certain destruction over unrepentant Nineveh, demonstrating that God's holiness will not overlook evil.
- Amid fiery warnings of judgment, God offers a verse of profound comfort and shelter for His people.
- The Lord’s intimate knowledge of those who trust Him guarantees their salvation and security.
- Believers are urged to seek refuge from judgment in the enduring peace of Jesus Christ.
